units.source_text: 武隈地方，以产夫妇松（双松并生者）著名。

en.t: The Takekuma region is famous for producing husband-and-wife pines, two pine trees growing side by side.

units.source_text: 此诗以夫妇松喻自己及明石姬，

en.t: In this poem, he compares the husband-and-wife pines to himself and the Lady of Akashi,

units.source_text: 并谓不久迎接她去同居。

en.t: and says that before long he will bring her to live with him.
